def split_keep_delimiters(s, delims):
    import re
    if not delims:
        return [s] if s else []
    pattern = '(' + '[' + re.escape(delims) + ']' + ')'
    pieces = re.split(pattern, s)
    return [p for p in pieces if p != '']
